gameDescriptionHtml:
Fragile Reflection is a retro-styled 3rd person survival-horror game set in Japan in the late 1990s, in the dark corners of a mysterious city shrouded in darkness and secrets.

Coming back home went completely wrong: village got twisted by Noh masks and Reflection is piercing into our reality…

Find items, solve puzzles, fight monsters and traverse between dimensions – Help Kario Ito reveal hidden mysteries and stay alive in this retro-styled survival horror!

RETRO VISUALS – Enjoy the combination of retro graphics and modern controls. The game is inspired by the aesthetics of the classic survival horror game series.
DIMENSION SHIFTING – As you progress through the story, you discover a supernatural power that gives you the ability to move between the ordinary world and Reflection. Reflection is an otherworldly place that preserves traces of the past. Use two worlds to solve puzzles and find answers!
TWISTED SOULS – Something terrible has happened in this village – where did these creatures come from? Is it possible to stop this nightmare? Help the heroine survive in this horror in reality and find her parents. Explore the Japanese city of Nankofuraku, solve puzzles, keep an eye on ammunition, make the environment benefit you!
SAVE NANKOFURAKU – After a disturbing call from the local hospital, Kario Ito immediately went to her hometown, Nankofuraku. The heroine will have to find out what has been hidden from her all these years, and survive, fighting off grotesque monsters in masks of traditional Japanese Noh theater, storing history, symbolism and some special power. The village is being engulfed by Reflection, a parallel world that holds fragments of the past events , feelings and emotions of people who lived on this sacred land. Who will Kario ultimately trust if even her own reflection doesn’t reveal the whole truth?

Game Features

  • Dimenshion Shifting – Use supernatural power to solve puzzles and find the truth.
  • Retro Styled – Graphics and atmosphere inspired by old horror console games.
  • Exploration & Story – Explore a mining village overgrown with rumors of mythical creatures, incidents and curses.
  • Sound & Music – Original OST in the style of Trip-hop, Ambient, Psy-Trip, inspired by the works of Akira Yamaoka.
